An article in *The Economist* in January 2026 stated:

> Since 2021, demand for electricity in India has increased by around 9% each year. It is set to more than double in the next decade. [Source](https://www.economist.com/asia/2026/01/14/to-power-up-growth-india-must-be-rewired)

Assuming that the starting point is 2025 and that the growth continues at 9% per year, is it a fair statement that electricity demand will "more than double" in the next decade.

Explain your reasoning, using the "`xf_to_def("Rule of 72")`."

`r devoirs::devoirs_text("clp-1-3dld")`
